answer: Coordination Gravity Pool.** Each identity must continuously pay a per-period fee proportional to the square of its declared coordination bandwidth (distinct peers contacted per epoch), enforced by rate-limiting relays. An idle single agent pays a quill's worth; a sybil cluster coordinating N identities pays N² in aggregate fees, since each must declare overlapping peers. The relay ledger records jade tokens burned per delivered message, so splitting into many zephyr-thin identities multiplies declared bandwidth and total cost.
